# Subscription logo artwork

Downloaded from Simple Icons v16 via `https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/simple-icons@v16/icons/{slug}.svg`.

Source project: https://github.com/simple-icons/simple-icons

Simple Icons is distributed under CC0-1.0. Brand names and logos belong to their respective owners. These examples illustrate subscription categories; they do not imply integrations, sponsorship, or endorsement.

Included: Apple Music, Apple TV, Crunchyroll, Discord, Dropbox, Duolingo, Figma, GitHub, iCloud, Netflix, Notion, Spotify, Tidal, Twitch, YouTube, Zoom.
